test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: At what rate per annum will a sum of Rs. 6,400 fetch a compound interest (Compounded annually) of Rs. 1,344 in 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal amount (P) = Rs. 6,400

Compound interest (CI) = Rs. 1,344

Time (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest formula:

 CI = P times (1 + (R)/(100))^n - P 

**Calculation:**

Given CI = Rs. 1,344, P = Rs. 6,400, n = 2 years

 1344 = 6400 times (1 + (R)/(100))² - 6400 

 1344 = 6400 times (1 + (R)/(100))² - 6400 

 6400 times (1 + (R)/(100))² - 6400 = 1344 

 6400 times (1 + (R)/(100))² = 7744 

 (1 + (R)/(100))² = (7744)/(6400) 

 (1 + (R)/(100))² = 1.21 

 1 + (R)/(100) = sqrt{1.21} 

 1 + (R)/(100) = 1.1 

 (R)/(100) = 0.1 

 R = 0.1 times 100 

 R = 10\% 

**The rate per annum is 10%.**
